mentions.name: Go board game server
mentions.description: A Go (the board game) server with a Rust backend, SQLite storage, and a Preact frontend. It is self-hosted on a Raspberry Pi and proxied to the public web via Tailscale; still unpolished but functional.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on a go (the game) server. still unpolished, but it's functional! currently hosted on a raspberry pi in my living room and proxied to the public Web via Tailscale.
Rust backend, SQLite, preact frontend.
mentions.author: sqwxl
